title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
abstract: arXiv:2611.14544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. This framing misses the errors that matter most. A misread that yields an illegal move is loud. One that yields a legal-but-wrong move is silent, because a legality-only pipeline accepts it and reads every later move against a wrong position. We therefore treat the task as game reconstruction and present Zugwise, which repurposes computer-chess machinery (quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, pin detection) to ask not "what should be played?" but "could a human plausibly have written this?" An absurdity detector makes silent errors loud at or near where they occur, and a backward search traces late symptoms to their cause. Candidate ranking excludes chess-quality signals. translated_title: Zugwise：面向手写国际象棋棋谱数字化的领域感知对局重建
translated_abstract: 手写国际象棋棋谱的数字化一直被作为手写识别问题来研究：读取每个格子中的着法，并验证其合法性。这种框架忽视了最关键的错误。误读后产生非法着法的错误是“响亮”的，容易被发现；而误读后产生合法却错误着法的错误则是“静默”的，因为仅基于合法性校验的流程会接受它，并在错误的局面下继续解读后续所有着法。因此，我们将该任务重新定义为对局重建，并提出 Zugwise 系统，它将计算机国际象棋的机制（静态搜索、静态交换评估、牵制检测）重新用于回答的问题不是“应该走哪步棋？”，而是“人类是否可能合理地写下这步棋？”。荒谬性检测器使静默错误在其发生处或附近变得“响亮”，反向搜索则将后期的症状追溯至其根源。候选着法排序刻意排除棋力质量信号。Needleman-Wunsch 合并将对局另一方的棋谱作为证据引入，审核停止点将每一处分歧……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 Zugwise，将手写国际象棋棋谱数字化从单纯的手写识别重新定义为对局重建问题，通过复用计算机象棋机制（静态搜索、静态交换评估、牵制检测）构建荒谬性检测器与反向搜索，使“合法但错误”的静默误读变得可被发现并可追溯至根源。
en_tdlr: Zugwise reframes handwritten chess scoresheet digitization as domain-aware game reconstruction rather than mere handwriting recognition, repurposing computer-chess machinery (quiescence search, static exchange evaluation, pin detection) with an absurdity detector and backward search to expose and localize silent legal-but-wrong misreadings.
